deviations.description: Extract columns 1, 4, 5, and 6 from both tables (with awk -F'|') and diff them
deviations.reason: A literal awk -F'|' split of an 8-pipe-delimited markdown table row places the Pass name at $2 and Gate/Destructive/Hourly-cadence at $5/$6/$7 (field 1 is the empty string before the leading pipe). Used columns 2/5/6/7 instead of a literal 1/4/5/6 to actually compare the intended content (Pass/Gate/Destructive/Hourly cadence), which is what both tables' lead-in paragraphs claim agreement on.
